title: #81 – Anca Dragan: Human-Robot Interaction and Reward Engineering
summary: Anca Dragan is a professor at Berkeley, working on human-robot interaction — algorithms that look beyond the robot’s function in isolation, and generate robot behavior that accounts for interaction and coordination with human beings.
